create_nested_dictionary_dataset: create a NestedDictionaryDataset from a nested dict of FairseqDataset objects with matching lengths
flatten_nested_dict: flatten a nested dictionary into dot-separated keys using the _flatten helper function
unflatten_dict: unflatten a dot-separated key dictionary back into a nested OrderedDict structure
collate_samples: collate a list of sample dicts into a mini-batch using each dataset's collater method
prefetch_dataset_indices: prefetch data for given indices across all nested datasets that support prefetching
